lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrSb₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Sr₄Sb₈) distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Sr and Sb centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each: Sr is coordinated by 12 Sb neighbors, while Sb has 4 Sr and 8 Sb neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Sb-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Sr- and Sb-centered polyhedra.
